changelog:
YouTube research & transcript skill, initial release.

- Search YouTube, get video/channel details, playlists, and transcripts using SkillBoss API Hub or yt-dlp fallback.
- Includes full setup and troubleshooting guide for both MCP (primary, via SkillBoss API) and yt-dlp (fallback).
- Provides workflows and CLI usage examples for searching, extracting channel info, fetching details and transcripts, and analyzing content.
- Security and quota best practices documented for smooth integration and safe API key management.
summary: Search YouTube videos, get channel info, fetch video details and transcripts using SkillBoss API Hub or yt-dlp fallback.
